Proposal FormYou chose this TATA AIG Bharat Griha Raksha Policy and applied to Us for insurance covers of your
choice. You paid Us the premium and gave Us information about yourself, your Home Building and your 
Home Contents. Based on your conﬁrmation that this information is true and correct, and in return of accepting the Premium you have paid Us, We promise to provide you insurance as stated in this Policy Document and the Policy Schedule attached to it.
Clause A. This Policy and the Insurance Contract: 
Your Policy: This  TATA AIG Bharat Griha Raksha Policy is a contract between you and Us as stated in the following: 1.
This Policy document,a.
The Policy Schedule attached to this Policy document,b.
Any Endorsement attached to and forming part of this Policy document,c.
Any Add-On to this Policy that you may have purchased from Us,d.
The Proposals and all declarations made by you or on your behalf.e.
Your personal details,a.
The Policy Period,b.
The description of your Insured Property,c.
The total Sum Insured, the Sum Insured for each cover or item covered, and any limits and sub-limits, d.
The insurance covers you have purchased,e.
The premium you have paid for these insurance covers,f.
Add-On covers opted by you,g.
Other important and relevant aspects and information.h.To whom this Policy is issued and what it covers:2.
This Policy is issued to you and covers you and/or your Home Building and/or Home Contents as 
mentioned in the Policy Schedule. a.
If more than one person is Insured under this Policy, each of you is a joint Policyholder. Any notice or letter We give to any of you will be considered as given to all of you. Any request, statement, representation, claim or action of any one of you will bind all of you as if made by all of you.b.
If you have mortgaged, pledged or hypothecated your Home Building and/or Home Content with a Bank, the Policy Schedule will show an ‘Agreed Bank Clause’ and the name of such Bank. The terms and conditions of this arrangement will be added to this Policy as an additional clause. c.
To whom this Policy is issued and what it covers:3.
Special meaning of certain words: Words stated in the table below have a special meaning 
throughout this Policy, the Policy Schedule and Endorsements.  These words with special meanings are stated in the Policy with the ﬁrst letter in capitals.4.
